Country.evidence_source: This study was approved by the Ethical Committee of the University Hospitals Leuven, Belgium.

Type.evidence_source: The Mini Mental State Examination (MMSE; Folstein, Folstein, & McHugh, 1975) was administered as part of the interview to assess the global cognitive functioning. The Suicide Intent Scale (SIS; Beck, Schuyler, & Herman, 1974) was administered to determine the suicidal intent of the SA.
